column1: # Cards that had a dirac/support/refused entry and no longer do, with the proof the defect is fixed.
# card <TAB> proof <TAB> why. The proof is a TestXxx that exists, or a dirac/oracle/testdata/repro/<name>.repro.json
# that replays clean (no divergence, no unmodelled stall) on a raw table of its own cards.
# TestUnrefusalNeedsProof fails for a card that had an entry at the merge base with land and has none now
# without a row here. An entry that went stale only because the pinned game moved is re-recorded

column3: the hidden public-origin pick now applies LibraryPosition$ (engine/effects/zone_hidden.go places what it moved), so the picked card lands on top of the library as dirac puts it
the resolving spell exiling itself (Origin$ Stack ChangeZone) leaves the stack at that op (dirac/interp_gen.go moveObj), so the untap pick after it sees it in exile and off the stack, as gorge does
a planned payment now activates its sacrificing sources last, as gorge orders its witness (dirac/mana.go), so the source tapped beside the Treasure matches when the Treasure's move waits on a choice

a cast whose shape gorge's potential planner refuses (an additional-cost forage or exile part, convoke, improvise, delve) takes no grant prefix in the kernel's grant and script searches (CR 601.2g-h), so the options the two engines offer match

the granted Attacks trigger's CR 603.3d placement offer now reads SVar:X from the grantor's table (Engine.triggerLineSVars in targetSpecContext), so with mana value 6 Old One Eye in the graveyard and X = the countered token's power 6 the trigger is placed with its target ask as dirac places it

a multi-target Destroy (up to three target creatures) is one simultaneous departure (dirac/zone_leavetogether.go), so the leaves and dies triggers of the victims see the same board as gorge and the two engines pose the same decisions

its pinned entry-order game (the land entering with an as-enters colour choice under the untap carrier) now replays clean past the CR 616.1 ask: the entering land's own as-enters choice record joins the ask (dirac/repl_entryorder.go entBodyRecord) and the answered choice survives the parked ask (dirac/turn_gen.go applyGen)

gorge's grant search (scriptSearch.visit) drops a payer state its seen key already holds before pricing it, so Gran-Gran's loot discarding the cast Rockalanche first shadows the discard of a Lesson that would let the hand cast be paid; the kernel's grant search priced that repeat and over-offered, and now drops it as gorge does (CR 601.2f, 106.4)

an announced Sac<X> activation with no {X} and no XMin is planned by gorge like any other cost (PlanCostDetail returns cost:x only for X or XMin, planCostParts skips the announced Sac part), so the kernel offers it when the pool pays the mana half (CR 602.2, 118.3); the XMin$ param fold on a Sac<X> ability is not mirrored by gorge (costAnnouncesX) and only Radiant Lotus, a mana ability, carries it
